mustFix.problem: Alt text reads 'Placeholder for [filename]' — not descriptive alt text for screen readers
mustFix.fix: Replace each placeholder alt with a description matching the data-fallback attribute or actual image content (e.g., 'Car headlights in blue winter twilight' for hero-C1)

elevate.move: Break the split-story repetition by turning the breakup section into a pinned scroll story where the frost-heave photo stays fixed while alignment/suspension service cards scroll past it, creating a distinct layout family that embodies the breakup thesis physically

Drive the thermo-rail temperature readout with a GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub so the mercury bulb physically rises/falls and the number ticks in sync with scroll position, making the signature moment a continuous motion narrative rather than discrete state changes
